storySteps.title: Ask Gerry about the cellar machine and expose its breakable wall
Break the cellar wall, remove the machine's corpse, and awaken it
Ask Horadric about the machine's statuette and receive Mrs Chain's lead
Question Mrs Chain about the statuette and follow her staged trip to the tavern
Ask Horadric about Mrs Chain's trip and receive Krezvold's lead
Question Krezvold twice and reopen Mrs Chain's secret
Hear Mrs Chain's secret, witness the tavern quarrel, and recover the first red eye
Offer the first red eye to Gerry and watch Horadric and Chain's ancient-villa memory
Finish the first memory, recover the red eye, and open the wine-flask lead
Follow the optional wine-flask hints and recover the flask from the Farmer's Son
Optionally tell the Farmer about his son and pay restitution
Offer the wine flask to Gerry and watch the Witch Hill memory
Finish the second memory and open the hinge and legionary-helmet leads
Collect the hinge from Gerry's cellar pile
Receive the Farmer's house visit and follow his lead about Clotho
Ask Clotho and Cory how to arrange the date
Choose whether to pay Tress for her date plan
Resolve the paid or denied date plan with Cory and Clotho
Trade a carrot crop for Clotho's giant carrot and deliver it to the Farmer
Independently recover the legionary helmet from the Farmer's house chest
Optionally try the legionary helmet before the third memory
Offer the hinge to Gerry and watch the aqueduct memory
Finish the third memory and open the real helmet memory
Offer the legionary helmet to Gerry and watch the parade memory
Finish the fourth memory and open the lock, medallion, and dagger leads
Search the Miller's land, help the Lighthouse Keeper, and exchange the invitation for the ancient lock
Optionally try the priest's medallion before the sixth memory
Offer the ancient lockpick to Gerry and watch the portal memory
Finish the sixth memory, recover the lockpick, and open the real medallion memory
Obtain booze for Dig and recover the priest's medallion
Offer the priest's medallion to Gerry and watch the colosseum memory
Finish the seventh memory, recover the medallion, and open the real dagger memory
Persuade Charm to sing for Krezvold and recover his dagger
Follow the Gypsy's leads and recover the separate rare dagger
Optionally try Krezvold's dagger before the seventh memory
Offer Krezvold's dagger to Gerry and watch the aqueduct memory
Finish the eighth memory and open the belt-buckle and pottery-shards leads
Follow the Logger and Beekeeper trail to recover the belt buckle
Upgrade the tavern, rescue Adam from Yorick, and recover the pottery shards
Optionally try the pottery shards before completing the tenth memory
Offer the belt buckle to Gerry and watch the tenth colosseum memory
Finish the tenth memory, recover the buckle, and open the real pottery-shards memory
Offer the pottery shards to Gerry and watch the ancient-villa memory
Finish the eleventh memory and open the amulet and shackles leads
Ask the Lighthouse Keeper and Snake how to obtain the ancient amulet
Help the Logger with curtains and roof tiles if Snake's relationship is below 90
Build the rat-race table, hold the first race, and collect the ancient amulet
Optionally study the obsidian and give its research to the Astrologer
Optionally try the shackles before completing the twelfth memory
Offer the ancient amulet to Gerry and watch the swamp memory
Finish the twelfth memory, recover the amulet, and open the real shackles memory
Offer the ancient shackles to Gerry and watch the dungeon memory
Finish the thirteenth memory and open the pickaxe, keys, and Witch Hill leads
Recover the clay pot of tar from Witch Hill
Ask Koukol about the pickaxe and obtain Clotho's scroll
Give Koukol the scroll and choose which dark organ he should obtain
Return to Koukol, improve the tavern, and collect the ancient pickaxe
Enter Adam's house and begin the search for three high-quality vases
Follow Adam's vase trail through the Merchant and Beekeeper to Dig
Recover Dig's poisoned pie and have the Beekeeper prepare poisoned vases
Return the poisoned vases to Adam and take the ancient keys from his house
Try the ancient keys before completing the fourteenth memory
Give Gerry the ancient pickaxe and watch the fourteenth memory
Finish the fourteenth memory and unlock the real ancient-key handoff
Give Gerry the ancient keys and watch the fifteenth memory
Finish the fifteenth memory and unlock the sixteenth-memory offerings
Try the three wrong offerings for the sixteenth memory
Give Gerry the clay pot of tar and watch the sixteenth memory
Finish the sixteenth memory and open the farmer-ring and priest-signet leads
Trace Bella's history through the Farmer's family, the Miller, and Clotho
Choose how to recover Bella's ring and open its handoff to Gerry
Trace the priest's signet through the Lighthouse Keeper, Koukol, and the Gypsy Baron
Buy the Gypsy's rat and exchange it with Dig for the priest's signet
Optionally try the priest's signet before starting the seventeenth memory
Give Gerry Bella's ring and watch the seventeenth memory
Finish the seventeenth memory and unlock the real signet handoff
Give Gerry the priest's signet and watch the eighteenth memory
Finish the eighteenth memory and open the search for the final brick
Collect the final brick from the spawned search object
Give Gerry the final brick and watch the nineteenth memory
Finish the nineteenth memory and launch the recovered ninth memory
Replay the ninth memory and open the buried treasure and keeper histories
Excavate Gerry's buried chest and collect its money
Optionally hear and view the four previous-Keeper histories
Activate the Portal and watch the Stranger Sins ending
